newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany set to complete beet plantings this week.
newsitem.headline: Germany set to complete beet plantings this week.

text.p: German farmers look set to complete sugar beet sowings this week, analysts said on Monday.
"Farmers made a good start last week, followed by some setbacks during a rainy weekend, but the work should be carried out this week," an official at the DWD national meteorological office said.
He said soils were drying quickly and that expected daytime temperatures between five and 10 degrees this week would aid field work.
A farm union official in Lower Saxony, the main growing state, said recent rainfall had been heavy, but farmers had completed most plantings in the first few days of April.
The 1997/98 area may slightly exceed the 516,452 hectares seen in 1696/97, sources have said.
A first area estimate is planned by sugar industry association WVZ for release in mid-April.
